crossRefs.note: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

translations.web: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
translations.bsb: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
translations.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translations.asv: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
